findings.objectiveReason: Ёбаный свет is an expletive addressing the situation/world, not a literal reference to light. Nuru introduces light as an object of the curse.

findings.currentTarget: Leper: Nuru ya kulaaniwa, una nini?
findings.objectiveReason: The same Russian expletive is mistranslated as literal nuru; the startled reproach is about the player drawing the gun, not lighting.
The preceding explicit antecedent is risasi, bullets, class 10 (and the slang ndizi also class 10). ku-yа- uses class 6 instead of ku-zi-.
Kwapa/underarms are class 5/6, requiring ya, not class 10 za; preserve all three source fragments.

findings.source: Unstable: Разве Гости от этого меньше убивают?
findings.currentTarget: Unstable: Wageni wataacha kuua kwa sababu hiyo?
findings.proposedFullTarget: Unstable: Je, hilo linawafanya Wageni wapunguze mauaji?
findings.objectiveReason: Russian asks whether Visitors kill less as a result, not whether they stop killing altogether. wataacha kuua changes the degree and shifts to a future cessation.
